results.title: Joy
results.overview: Joy attends her best friend Aron's 30th birthday party. The mood is lighthearted and boisterous, until Joy grabs the microphone and derails the party with a revelation.

results.title: New Mother-in-law
results.overview: Viktor Suslov finds himself back in the maelstrom of family passions: now he lives under the thumb of a new mother-in-law, with her single-handedly established rules and strict house rules. An already difficult life is disrupted by the sudden arrival of Viktor's twin brother, Tokha. The domestic "idyll" is bursting at the seams when, not without the participation of the mother-in-law, the former enmity of the two brothers flares up again. The situation is aggravated by the appearance on the doorstep of FSIN officers looking for Tokha.

results.title: Wacken - Hearts Full of Metal
results.overview: Mud, power outages, heavy rain – and yet Wacken draws crowds every year. For over three decades, Wacken Open Air has stood for friendship, perseverance, and a tight-knit community. With metal legends such as Kreator, Doro Pesch, and Motörhead, Wacken turns into an exceptional event – and a home away from home for fans from all over the world.

results.title: Hekla
results.overview: Hekla, a determined Chicago actress, races through auditions, breakups, and self-doubt over the course of one chaotic day, risking her heart and career to claim her voice and step fully into the artist and woman she's meant to be.

results.title: Anna, Postmortem
results.overview: When a young woman is murdered for mysterious reasons, her ghost searches for answers - and revenge.

results.title: The Laksman
results.overview: As panic spreads, the past claws its way into the present, Betty Rae is forced to confront a darkness woven into her family's story, turning Halloween night into a deadly reckoning.

results.title: Buddies and the Heir
results.overview: Following the death of a hotelier in Punta del Este, Uruguay, an unexpected inheritance dispute begins. Stallone, an actor with Down syndrome, believes he is the rightful heir to the hotel. On the other side is Magrelo, a young autistic man who was raised as an adopted son by the deceased. Without waiting for the reading of the will, Stallone decides to reunite his old friends with Down syndrome from the institute where they lived in Brazil to spend a week's vacation at the hotel.

results.title: The Evil Inside
results.overview: Once a showbiz icon in Taiwan, Ho Jen-jen—better known as Golden Phoenix—vanished after reckless gambling left her drowning in debt. She abandoned her young daughter, severing all ties. Years later, she collapses and wakes up in a sinister nursing home. Beneath the facility’s eerie calm lurks "Death Bet,” a twisted game where terminal patients' lifespans are gambled away. Desperate to escape and find her daughter, she soon realizes the true horror has yet to unfold, and the most harrowing secret is still waiting to be revealed.

results.title: Yiya Murano: Death at Tea Time
results.original_title: Yiya Murano: Muerte a la hora del té
results.overview: Yiya Murano poisoned her friends to cover up scams in 1970s Argentina and became a dark figure in popular culture. Freed in the 1990s, she reappeared as a pop icon. Today, her son Martín seeks to reveal her true face.

results.title: Convulsions
results.overview: A young man dies, and his flickering consciousness blends in a maelstrom of fading symbols and memories. He has to forgo what bound him to life, accept the inexorable, and enter the void.

results.title: Vaa Vaathiyaar
results.overview: After being raised as the reincarnation of a famous actor, a man finds himself clashing with his grandfather's expectations of him.

results.title: Camera Obscura
results.overview: David is a street photographer, and is drawn into a surreal underworld in an attempt to save himself and a mysterious girl; who disappears supernaturally.

results.title: Stepmother
results.overview: Middle-aged Zuza starts a new relationship with Kuba. With him, his six-year-old son, Franek, enters her life. Whether she likes it or not, Zuza becomes the boy's foster mother. A unique bond develops, but trouble arises when her relationship with Kuba starts to fall apart. "Stepmother" is an intimate story about love that transcends traditional family roles, the right to one's emotions, and how the most unexpected choices prove to be the right ones.

results.title: Agnes Mot Verden
results.overview: Norwegian film written & directed by David B. Berget

results.title: The Infinite
results.overview: Charlie Donovan, on the brink of losing everything he loves, is drawn into a fateful journey with seven strange strangers, each of whom holds a key to save him from self-destruction.

results.title: Little Taleteller
results.overview: Renata and Eduard are a happily married couple. They are expecting a baby. Their idyllic life is shattered by sudden, inexplicable changes in Renata's personality. The changes become final when she displays no feelings and maternal instincts for their newborn son.

results.title: God's Shirt
results.overview: During the 1986 World Cup in Mexico, in the legendary match between Argentina and England, Diego Maradona scored two unforgettable goals in a game that meant more than sport for a nation scarred by the Falklands War. Decades later, when the jersey he used in the match is auctioned, a humble kit man shaped by profound loss sets out on a final journey that forces him to confront his past and his broken relationship with his daughter.
